newsitem.title: POLAND: PLI SETS NEW SHARE ISSUE PRICE AT PLN 5.
newsitem.headline: PLI SETS NEW SHARE ISSUE PRICE AT PLN 5.

text.p: Wholesaler and retailer Polish Life Improvement (PLI) SA has set a price of its new, 3,525,607-share issue at five zlotys a share, the firm said in a statement on Friday.
The record date for issue, with rights going one-for-two, is August 30.

The first subscription for PLI's holders will take place between August 11 and September 1. If any shares remain unclaimed, the second subscription for the holders will be ogranised between September 22 and October 6.
Another subscription, open to the public, will be staged between October 24 and 28, if any shares are left for sale.
The current capital of PLI, listed on the parallel market, is divided into 7,051,213 shares.
